title: Magnitude 7.1 quake strikes Japan's Kumamoto; TSMC activates emergency protocols at local fab
content: A powerful earthquake struck Japan's Kyushu region at 4:27 p.m. on July 28. The Japan Meteorological Agency initially estimated the quake at magnitude 7.1 with a depth of 6.2 miles (10 kilometers). The strongest shaking was recorded in Uki City and Hikawa Town in Kumamoto Prefecture, reaching seismic intensity 7 on Japan's scale. TSMC's Japan fab in Kikuyo Town experienced an intensity of 5+, and a tsunami warning was issued.

title: Squeezed by China, Taiwan ODMs pivot to AI for new growth
content: China's notebook manufacturing industry is rising rapidly just as Taiwan's ODMs retreat from notebook assembly, but Wistron chairman Simon Lin said the shift also reflects new opportunities as companies pivot toward AI. Lin said each era has its own mission, and many companies would rather move notebook resources into other areas.

title: Samsung trims Z Fold8 display module 10% using Flex Titanium

title: Automotive chip demand surges in 2Q26 on EV reset
content: Automotive chip demand surprised to the upside in the second quarter of 2026, with industry players saying the market could stay hot in the second half as new EV architectures become clearer and customers rebuild inventories. The strongest signal came from Texas Instruments (TI), which said the strength in automotive chips was completely unexpected.

title: Google TPU surge and Meta capacity push fuel CSP capex wave
